verdict.rationale: Granola's dedicated consent/transparency docs say it posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing. That is a real in-meeting disclosure and participant notification, not just a policy document. The evidence is a single doc snippet with no detail. Missing for 10: evidence that admins can enforce or mandate the disclosure across the workspace, coverage details per platform (Zoom/Meet/Teams, in-person/mobile), configurability documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
